title: Curium and Lantheus Agree to an Up-to-$8 Billion Merger: Radiopharma Becomes a Full-Stack Business
summary: The $7 billion Curium-Lantheus rumor covered in June became a definitive agreement on August 3: $102.50 in cash plus up to $12.00 per share in CVRs, for total consideration of up to $8 billion. The strategic prize is an integrated chain spanning isotopes, manufacturing, distribution, diagnostics, therapy and U.S. hospital access.
cover_image_alt: A radiopharma loop connecting isotope production, timed distribution, PSMA PET imaging, targeted treatment and follow-up
